```{r}
#| results: asis
tiles <- yaml::read_yaml("_data/tiles.yml")
esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(x %||% "")
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
cat('```{=html}\n<section class="tiles-grid">\n')
for (tile in tiles) {
  title <- esc(tile$title)
  description <- tile$description %||% ""
  image <- esc(tile$image)
  href <- esc(tile$href)
  cat(sprintf('  <article class="tile-card" style="--tile-image: url(\'%s\')">\n    <a href="%s" aria-label="%s"></a>\n    <div class="tile-body">\n      <h2>%s</h2>\n      <p>%s</p>\n    </div>\n  </article>\n', image, href, title, title, description))
}
cat('</section>\n```\n')
```
